            triggered_desc = { trigger = { has_global_variable = oe_mo_despotate } desc = oe_lgr.20.desc_0d }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { OR = { var:oe_lat_varna ?= 1 var:oe_lat_varna ?= 2 } } desc = oe_lgr.20.desc_0v }
            triggered_desc = { desc = oe_lgr.20.desc_0 }
        }
    }
    trigger = { is_rebel_country = no tag = BYZ oe_lgr_ev_20 = yes }
    immediate = { oe_ml_take_as = { line = 24 } location:athens = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_lgr_ath20 } } }
    option = {
        name = oe_lgr.20.a
        trigger = { oe_lgr_can_pay = { months = 2 } scope:oe_lgr_ath20 ?= { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } OR = { is_subject = no overlord ?= { is_ai = yes NOT = { tag = BYZ } } } } }
        custom_tooltip = oe_lgr.20.a.tt
        hidden_effect = { oe_lgr_pay = { months = 2 } if = { limit = { monthly_manpower > 0 } add_manpower = { value = monthly_manpower multiply = -2 } } if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lgr_b_thebes_tur target = c:BYZ } } } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_thebes20 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_do value = 20 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_lgr.90 }
        ai_chance = { base = 40 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_lgr.20.b
        trigger = { scope:oe_lgr_ath20 ?= { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } } }
        custom_tooltip = oe_lgr.20.b.tt
        hidden_effect = { oe_lgr_gain = { months = 2 } scope:oe_lgr_ath20 ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_lgr_b_thebes_tribute target = c:BYZ } } set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_thebes20 value = 2 } }
        ai_chance = { base = 35 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_lgr.20.c
        custom_tooltip = oe_lgr.20.c.tt
        hidden_effect = { set_variable = { name = oe_lgr_thebes20 value = 3 } }
        ai_chance = { base = 25 }
    }
}

# Hidden worker, fired from the options (var:oe_lgr_do): the heavy effects stay out of the option preview. It takes
# no lock.
oe_lgr.90 = { # 拉丁希腊：执行
    type = country_event
    hidden = yes
    title = oe_lgr.90.t
    trigger = { is_rebel_country = no tag = BYZ }
    immediate = { oe_lgr_do_job = yes }
}
